gotchas.note: defaultOpen lives on AccordionItem, not Accordion. Pass it per item: <AccordionItem title="…" defaultOpen>.
Trigger is a button with aria-expanded; do not nest interactive elements inside title.

agent.usage:
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from @/components/atoms/Accordion;

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Shipping" defaultOpen>
    Ships in 2–3 days.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Returns">
    30-day window.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
